title: There are no lightsabers in The Mandalorian and Grogu,  a...
content: There are no lightsabers in The Mandalorian and Grogu, a first for Star Wars films. There are also no Wilhelm screams in the movie, which is weird because I thought I heard snippets of it everywhere (even Mando’s blaster sounded a little Wilhelm-ish).
author: Jason Kottke
